notes: Leaching Method: Wash the vegetables thoroughly and peel off the skin. Cut the vegetables into small pieces. Soak them in a large amount of water for 2–4 hours. Completely drain and discard the soaking water. Rinse the vegetables again with fresh water. Cook the vegetables in plenty of fresh water. After cooking, drain and discard the cooking water. If needed, prepare the final dish using fresh water.
Important Note: Strictly avoid Raw Tomato and carrot
Important Note : Strictly avoid Green leafy vegetables

recipeGroups.heading: Category 1

recipes.name: Option 1: Cucumber and Onion salad
steps: Thinly slice the cucumbers and red onion.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced cucumbers and red onions.
You can add a splash of lemon juice over the cucumber and onion mixture.
Add salt and pepper as per your taste.

recipes.name: Option 2: Radish and cucumber slice salad
steps: Wash the radish thoroughly. Trim off the ends of the radishes and thinly slice them. Peel the onion,wash thoroughly and slice them.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced radishes and onion.
You can add a splash of lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Option 3: CCC chop salad (Cucumber Capsicum Cabbage)
ingredients: ½ red bell pepper (capsicum), thinly chopped
steps: Wash the cucumber, red bell pepper, and cabbage thoroughly. Trim off the ends of the cucumber and chop it. Remove the seeds and membranes from the red bell pepper and thinly slice it. Thinly slice the cabbage.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, red bell pepper, and cabbage.
You can add a splash of lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Option 4: Mixed vegetable salad
ingredients: 1 bell pepper (capsicum), diced (any color you prefer)
1 cup mixed salad greens (such as Cabbage), torn into bite-sized pieces
steps: Wash and dice the cucumber, and bell pepper. Thinly slice the red onion. Tear the salad greens into bite-sized pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the diced cucumber, bell pepper,, sliced red onion, and torn salad greens.
You can add a splash of lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently toss to coat the vegetables evenly with the dressing.

recipeGroups.heading: Salad Law
freeText: SALAD LAWS
Daily intake for legumes should be 50 - 100 grams (boiled).
If you feel bloating issues, add more vegetables in your bowl.
Avoid adding beetroot, potato and tubers in vegetable bowls.
Add different varieties of vegetables in your bowl.

recipeGroups.heading: Water Law
freeText: Water Law
As per your doctor's advice, take water consumption per day.
If any water restriction is there for you, kindly inform the health coach.
Take only 200 ml detox tea in your daily routine.
